messages:
anya: Quick sync — scheduling a base-image rebuild Thu 08:00 PT. Goals: drop CAP_NET_RAW, tighten seccomp, enable userns remap, and rotate cosign signer + move keystore operator to per-cluster KMS aliases.

ben: rolling canary plan? prefer internal -> staging -> prod-canary -> rest, 10m windows with health checks.

drew: RBAC housekeeping first. bake-runner SA has cluster-admin in a couple of test namespaces. I'll open a migration PR to scope to job.create and pod.create and add audit annotation `sec.redwood/audit=SEC-8410`.

kyla: KMS detail: infra will create per-cluster KEKs. who grants keystore-operator kms:Decrypt/Encrypt?

anya: infra will pre-create keys; ben will own granting the IAM bindings for the operator and run a CI access-check job.

ben: audit retention question — SOC wants 1y WORM. plan: write audit batches to WORM bucket encrypted with cluster KEK and attach a cosign-signed manifest per upload. infra-bot: created ticket SEC-8410 for retention + manifest schema.

drew: build pipeline changes: generate SBOM, cosign attestation, and ensure reproducible build flags. small snippet added in PR.

kyla: incident runbook: if rewrap fails, fallback = decrypt with old KEK and re-encrypt. who authors runbook?

anya: kyla + drew will own runbook. include explicit gcloud commands and a short-lived impersonation step for oncall approval.

ben: preflight checks for rollout team:
```
# verify capabilities are dropped
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop}' | grep NET_RAW && echo BAD || echo OK
# cosign verify
cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign registry.redwood/base:sha
# userns check
grep -q userns /proc/filesystems || echo userns-missing
```

infra-bot: checklist: [ ] RBAC PR merged (annotated SEC-8410), [ ] per-cluster KEKs provisioned, [ ] cosign signer rotated & tested, [ ] SBOM+attestation green, [ ] canary schedule, [ ] runbook attached to SEC-8410.

anya: small edge — legacy pcap sidecar needs NET_RAW. plan to move it to a restricted debug daemonset on a dedicated nodepool rather than granting app pods the cap.

drew: I'll add alerts: trigger incident if >3 failed rewraps in 10m or cosign verify fails for promoted tag.

kyla: I'll author runbook and post link to SEC-8410 today. pairing on RBAC with drew at 2pm.

anya: thanks team — will post 30m heads-up in #release-war-room before starting. :shield:
